request: Analyze GSE97718 for the paper (Exercise and high-fat feeding remodel transcript-metabolite interactive networks in mouse skeletal muscle): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (TruSeq stranded mRNA, HiSeq 2500), mouse quadriceps

exercise: post (3 h after one maximal treadmill bout)

final.sample_inclusion: 2x2 factorial, n = 4 muscles per group (FIG2/FIG3/FIG4 legends), independent male C57BL/6NTac mice; all 16 GEO samples
final.primary_estimand: Acute maximal exercise effect (post vs pre, 3 h) on quadriceps gene expression within CON-diet mice and within HFD mice (between-animal, not repeated measures)
planned_contrasts: CON-post vs CON-pre (S2.2.p1; paper: 292 up + 109 down = 401 DEGs)
HFD-post vs HFD-pre (S2.2.p1; paper: 208 up + 115 down = 323 DEGs)
HFD-pre vs CON-pre (S2.1.p2; paper: 119 up + 93 down = 212 DEGs) - diet effect, secondary
HFD-post vs CON-post (S2.2.p3; paper: 234 DEGs) - diet effect post-exercise, secondary
final.repeated_measure_unit: none (pre and post are different animals, S4.4.p1)

paper_threshold.note: Paper says only that comparisons were done with cufflinks; no FDR/fold-change rule is stated (Cuffdiff's default 'significant' flag is q < 0.05, but that is not written in the paper). S4.9.p1 p < 0.05 refers to physiological t-tests/ANOVA.

final.paper_results: DEG counts in S2.1.p2/S2.2.p1/S2.2.p3; named genes: Ppargc1a and Nr4a3 (exercise reverts HFD-pre pattern, S2.2.p3), Egr1 and Klf5 induced by exercise mainly in CON (S2.2.p2), Cited2/Dusp10/Trp63 induced in CON but abrogated in HFD (S3.p4), Pfkfb3 down and Tbc1d1 up in HFD-pre (S2.1.p2)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Methods S4.1/S4.4: CON vs HFD for 10 weeks, then basal (pre) or 3 h after a maximal treadmill test (post). RNA-seq S4.6.p1 with Cufflinks; n = 4 per group (FIG3). The paper's question about exercise is the post vs pre comparison within each diet (S2.2.p1); the diet contrasts (S2.1.p2, S2.2.p3) are secondary.
